plain: Abandoning a duty, post, or family.

webster.text: The act of forsaking or abandoning, as a party, a friend, a country, an army or military band, or a ship; the act of quitting, with an intention not to return.

example.quote: I was solicited to argue this cause as Advocate-General; and, because I would not, I have been charged with desertion from my office.
example.cite: James Otis, Argument Against Writs of Assistance, 1761
